thread:
maya: Hey team — I've got my first PR ready but want to make sure I follow conventions. A couple quick q's: do we prefer squash merges or merge commits for feature branches? Also what's our branch naming pattern? And where's the canonical style/linters config (I couldn't find a single doc).

sam: welcome, maya! :tada: we generally squash for feature work unless it's a long-lived integration branch. Branch naming: `feature/<ticket>-short-desc` or `fix/<ticket>-short` for bugfixes. Docs live in the repo but split — see below.

maya: thanks — can you point to the exact files? I looked at repo root and found `CONTRIBUTING.md` but it's light.

liam: hey -- quick notes from the reviewers side: squash = yes for tidy history, but keep individual commits while drafting so reviewers can see progress. When you're ready, squash before merging. For release branches we keep merge commits.

chris: adding where to look: primary sources are `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` for process, `tools/lint-config/` for ESLint + prettier, and `docs/dev/pr-guidelines.md` for stylistic expectations. We should add a single top-level pointer, good catch, maya.

maya: git commands sanity check: if I want to squash interactively before push, use `git rebase -i HEAD~4` then `git push --force-with-lease`? Any preferred workflow?

liam: yes that's fine. We prefer `--force-with-lease`. If it's a PR that others are reviewing, say in the PR description that you rebased/force-pushed so people don't lose comments.

sam: also run `make check` locally — that runs lint, typecheck, and unit tests quick check. CI will run full suite. If `make check` fails, fix before pushing.

maya: where do I add the changelog / release notes? small bugfix probably won't need a formal changelog entry.

chris: for non-user-visible changes we skip changelog. For anything user-facing, add a short line to `docs/releases/unreleased.md` under your PR number.

maya: cool. One more — PR review etiquette: how many approving reviews before merge? Is there an auto-merge policy?

liam: 1 approval + green CI for most subsystems, 2 approvals for infra/critical paths (see `CODEOWNERS`). We have an auto-merge bot (`pr-bot`) that merges when criteria met and the merge window is open.

pr-bot: Automated message: To enable auto-merge add the label `merge/auto` to your PR. The bot will attempt to merge when CI passes and approvals are satisfied.

maya: awesome, thanks. I'll update the PR description with the checklist and add `merge/auto` after CI passes.

sam: welcome again — if you want I can drop a tiny PR that adds a top-level pointer to `docs/dev/pr-guidelines.md` from `CONTRIBUTING.md` so it's easier to find.

maya: please! that'd help new folks a lot. Thanks everyone :pray:

liam: quick example blurb for the PR description you can copy:```
### PR checklist
- run `make check` locally
- branch name: `feature/1234-short-desc`
- squash commits before merge (unless marked WIP)
- add `merge/auto` label to request auto-merge
```

chris: I'll follow up to add a short note in `docs/` linking the scattered configs. Nice first-PR questions, maya.

maya: thanks all — merging once CI is green. :rocket:
